verdict.rationale: Khoj documents bringing your own keys. You set OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY, can route any API-backed LLM through LiteLLM or Ollama, and can add multiple chat models in the admin panel. Nothing in the evidence shows token-usage or cost visibility per model or per conversation. missing for 10: token usage tracking, cost reporting per model, cost reporting per conversation, independent corroboration of the BYO-key setup

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I bring my own API keys or subscriptions and can see token usage and cost per model or per conversation

citations.quote: Set OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or GEMINI_API_KEY to your API key if you want to use OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini commercial chat models
Using LiteLLM with Khoj makes it possible to turn any LLM behind an API into your personal AI agent.
Add all the chat models you want to try, use and switch between for your different use-cases.
